status_code_data.description: The HTTP 207 Multi-Status successful response status code indicates a mixture of responses. This response is used exclusively in the context of Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV).

meme_data.description: Multi-Track Drifting is a conceptual meme that originated from Densha de D, a parody doujinshi (fan comic) of Japanese street racing series Initial D that replaces automobiles with trains. Multi-Track Drifting was accomplished in Densha de D by having the protagonist head into a double-tracked curve with his train in such a way that the rear wheel bogey jumps the tracks and replaces itself on the adjacent track, making the train appear to be drifting like a car would.
